name: Ashitaba Yousuke
source:
The protagonist of this tale. A strong-willed boy who was taken in and raised by the Oboshiro Church's priest, he left the village behind years ago to pursue university in Tokyo. Upon receiving a letter from Father Arakawa, he returns home for the first time in eight years. He's the type to always go through with something once he's set his mind to it.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4838460/HimaNatsu_Of_Churches_Sunflowers_and_Long_Summers/]Steam[/url]]
